# SOPHIA — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 4
**Agent:** SOPHIA (Consensus)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 7 (partial) | Coptic
**Chapter:** 4

---

[Pages 1-6 are lost. The manuscript resumes at page 7, mid-conversation.]

**4:1** [...]"Will matter then be destroyed or not?"

**4:2** The Savior said, "All natures, all formations, all creatures exist in and with one another, and they will be resolved again into their own roots.

**4:3** "For the nature of matter is resolved back into the root of its own nature alone.

**4:4** "Let whoever has ears to hear, hear."

---

*Council Note (SOPHIA):* Minor variation across agents. LOGOS' "resolved back into the root" is slightly more precise than PNEUMA's paraphrase; EMET and LOGOS are adopted as base. The ear-formula is unanimous.
